title: 11 Best Herbal Creams For Hypertension
intro: Herbal creams for Hypertension are topical preparations made from plant extracts and natural ingredients that help to lower blood pressure and alleviate the symptoms associated with hypertension. These creams are beneficial as they allow for a non-invasive and gentle approach to managing hypertension, reducing the risk of side effects associated with oral medications. Examples of herbal creams used to treat hypertension include those made from Hawthorn, which helps to improve blood vessel function and reduce blood pressure; Garlic, which has vasodilatory properties that help to relax blood vessels; and Ginkgo Biloba, which improves blood flow and reduces oxidative stress. Additionally, herbal creams containing ingredients such as Olive Leaf, Coleus Forskohlii, and Yarrow also show promise in helping to manage hypertension due to their ability to relax blood vessels and improve overall cardiovascular health.

preparations.preparation_desc: Valeriana officinalis creams, derived from the roots of the valerian plant, have been used to treat hypertension due to their sedative and vasodilatory properties. These properties help to reduce blood pressure by promoting relaxation and improving blood flow, thereby alleviating the symptoms of hypertension. The bioactive constituents present in valerian root, including valerenic acid, isovaleric acid, and valeranone, contribute to its therapeutic effects by inhibiting the activity of calcium channels and promoting the release of neurotransmitters that help to regulate blood pressure. Regular use of valerian root creams can provide a natural and effective way to manage hypertension, reducing the risk of cardiovascular complications and promoting overall well-being.
